title: Patch Notes 0.207 – Fall's Faire: Frights & Delights
raw: [p][b][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/qyr5bjm559gz/33LzSp0qCGzU57WZTGhrSx/f2573464f35a1eacb3fa23dc4711b9b5/207Header_Clean_ForWeb.jpg" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/b][/p][h2][b]At a Glance[/b][/h2][p][b][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/qyr5bjm559gz/1F546KmzLMYuY9XU4sf0eL/f7e321012e6cfd8f417f09bb70dc817b/Pattern_Line_02.png" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/b][/p][p align="start"][b]As the nights grow longer and moonlight settles over Kilima Village, a familiar kind of mischief stirs… Spiritfest returns in Fall’s Faire: Frights & Delights, bringing plenty of tricks, treats, and delightfully spooky surprises! Pay a visit to the Spooky Moon Store, stock up on Ectoplasm, Tattered Cloth, and other eerie essentials, lend Elouisa a hand at the Bulletin Board, and brave the newest Lunar Path: Path of the Ghastly. Give your home a little Spiritfest makeover with coffins, gargoyles, bottled poison, new Coven and Candy Corn Tints, spooky Plushes, and plenty more; then welcome the Palcat to your Ranch, and grow even closer with Sifuu, Hassian, Taylin, and Ulfe. And, of course, the Premium Store is getting dressed up for the occasion with Devilish Imp, Casual Cutie, Fungi Forager, the Palcat Rogue, Haunted Hollow Landscape, and more frighteningly fun additions. So light the candles, grab a friend, and follow that mysterious rustling in the pumpkin patch. Something wonderfully spooky is waiting in the dark![/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Here's a snapshot of the new Gameplay content coming to Patch 0.207:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Spiritfest is back, and the Spooky Moon Store is open for business! 🎃[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Help Elouisa ghost-bust in the new Bulletin Board quest! 🧦[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Brave the newest Lunar Path: Path of the Ghastly! 👻[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Welcome the paw-sitively adorable Palcat to your Ranch! 🐈‍⬛[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Grow closer with Sifuu, Hassian, Taylin, and Ulfe with Friendship Level 5 Quests! 💌[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Deck out your Home Plot with new Spiritfest Decor! 🪦[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Give your home a frightfully festive makeover with new Tints! 🕯️[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Plushes add a lil’ spooky splendor to your collection! 🧸[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Claim a Spiritfest Player Title… but choose wisely! 🤔[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Show off with spook-tacular new Spiritfest Nameplates and Profile Icons! 🖼️[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Haunt in style with new Premium Store arrivals, including the Devilish Imp, Casual Cutie, Fungi Forager, the Palcat Rogue, the Haunted Hollow Landscape, and more! 🦇[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]…and more![/b][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Table of Contents[/b][/h2][p][b][img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/qyr5bjm559gz/1F546KmzLMYuY9XU4sf0eL/f7e321012e6cfd8f417f09bb70dc817b/Pattern_Line_02.png" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0px; max-width: 100%;"][/img][/b][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p]Jump to...[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b
